rationale: param_efficient-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=RECOMBINATION(b) at 0.09 — add an IMAGE-DOMAIN ORIENTED ANISOTROPIC term for RESIDUAL DIRECTIONAL streaks on top of the iter-28 champion (FoE+gentle Manduca PROJECTION filter, val hr 0.3942 @ 1,926p). [1 PRIOR] iter-28 (FoE+Manduca, 0.3942) is the 0.09 champion; iter-30 (FoE+Manduca+ISOTROPIC image bilateral) REGRESSED to 0.3812 — the isotropic image bilateral is REDUNDANT on the projection-domain streak fix (no gain). [2 FAILURE MODE] iter-30 showed an ISOTROPIC image prior cannot catch what Manduca leaves; but LD-CT streaks are DIRECTIONAL (photon-starved high-attenuation rays backproject as oriented streaks) and the gentle Manduca filter must stay soft (view-consistency) so it deliberately leaves residual directional streaks. An isotropic filter is the wrong tool for an oriented artifact. [3 ONE KNOB] add a config-gated ZERO-INIT-gain oriented anisotropic-smoothing residual ON TOP of FoE+Manduca: reg(x)=FoE(x)+gain*Sum_theta(x-G_theta(x)), G_theta = oriented anisotropic Gaussian (elongated ALONG theta sigma_along=2.0px, narrow ACROSS sigma_across=0.6px) at M=4 FIXED orientations {0,45,90,135}deg; analytic kernels (NO trainable conv weights), 2 shared learnable sigmas + 1 ZERO-INIT shared gain = +3 params (NOT a steerable/equivariant FoE reparam — that DIVERGED iter-24). Total 1,929p. Everything else iter-26/iter-7 byte-for-byte (K=5 tied prox+DC, single alpha, no momentum/per-step-alpha, peak lr 5e-3, partial cosine T_max=16, max_train_s=1080, train_n=200, val_n=214, mu>=0 only NO upper clamp, Manduca proj_filter_on=true). [4 HYPOTHESIS] a DIRECTION-aware image prior catches the residual directional streaks the isotropic bilateral (iter-30) could not -> hr > 0.3942. Realistic NULL: gain->0, hr~0.394 (Manduca subsumes image-domain streak cleanup) — a clean publishable result. [5 SELF-CHECK] VERIFIED offline (cluster CPU): aniso_gain=0 => term==0 EXACTLY regardless of sigmas/orientations; ||reg-FoE||==0 at init => pipeline==iter-28 byte-for-byte; FoE(x)==0 (zero-init RBF); params=FoE1920+alpha1+Manduca5+aniso3=1929. [6 SAFETY] zero-init => worst case == champion (no divergence/regression risk).
